title: Field Technician Voice Reporting
summary: Linemen, fitters and plant technicians speak their job report in Hindi or a regional language, and the system turns it into a structured CMMS entry for supervisor approval.

seo.title: Field Technician Voice Reporting with AI | VipraTech
seo.description: Voice reporting for linemen and maintenance crews: speak in Hindi or a regional language, get structured job reports and spares entries for approval.

problem.intro: After restoring a transformer, changing an idler or clearing a breakdown, technicians are expected to fill a job completion report, record spares used and note the cause. Gloves, poles, poor connectivity and small phone keyboards mean reports are written hours later from memory, if at all.

pain_points.title: Late reports written from memory
pain_points.detail: Restoration times, causes and readings are reconstructed at the end of the shift and often lose detail.

pain_points.title: Free text nobody can analyse
pain_points.detail: Typed notes like 'fuse changed, ok now' cannot be trended to find repeat faults on the same asset.

pain_points.title: Typing is impractical in the field
pain_points.detail: Technicians on poles, in conveyor galleries or wearing gloves cannot easily fill long mobile forms.

pain_points.title: Spares used but not recorded
pain_points.detail: Materials drawn for a job are not booked against it, so store balances and job costs drift.

solution.overview: We build a voice reporting flow for the mobile app your crews already carry, or a phone number they can call. The technician speaks naturally in Hindi, Hinglish or a regional language, mixing in technical terms such as DT, HT fuse, ABC cable, isolator, idler or gearbox. Speech recognition tuned to that vocabulary produces a transcript, and a language model fills the report template: asset, complaint or work order number, fault, cause, action taken, spares used and restoration time. If a mandatory field is missing, the app asks for it by voice. Photos attach to the report, recordings queue offline, and a supervisor approves before anything updates the CMMS or store records.
capabilities: Speech capture in Hindi, Hinglish and regional languages with domain vocabulary
Fills job completion, breakdown and outage restoration templates
Asks follow-up questions by voice for missing mandatory fields
Matches spoken asset names and spares to asset tags and store codes
Offline recording with automatic sync when the network returns
Supervisor approval queue with transcript, audio and photos side by side

workflow.title: Record at job end
workflow.detail: The technician opens the job in the app, or calls the reporting number, and describes the work by voice, attaching photos.

workflow.title: Transcribe
workflow.detail: Speech recognition with your vocabulary produces a transcript and handles code-mixed speech.

workflow.title: Fill the template
workflow.detail: A language model maps the transcript to report fields and matches assets and spares to codes.

workflow.title: Check completeness
workflow.detail: If mandatory fields such as cause or restoration time are missing, the app asks for them by voice.

workflow.title: Supervisor approval
workflow.detail: The junior engineer or supervisor reviews the draft with audio and photos, then approves or returns it.

workflow.title: Update systems
workflow.detail: Approved reports update the work order in the CMMS, the outage record and spares consumption in stores.

inputs: Voice notes or calls from technicians
Photos of the asset before and after the job
Asset register and spares catalogue with store codes
outputs: Structured job completion and breakdown reports
Outage restoration times recorded against complaints
List of reports returned for correction
human_in_the_loop: A supervisor or junior engineer approves every report before it updates the CMMS, outage records or inventory. Permit-to-work closure and line clearance remain with the authorised person under your existing procedure; the system only drafts the report.
integrations: SAP PM, IBM Maximo or another CMMS
ERP stores module such as SAP MM
Microsoft Teams or WhatsApp for supervisor notifications
guardrails: Never closes a permit-to-work or declares equipment safe
Asks rather than guesses when a field is unclear
Asset and spares matches shown with alternatives for confirmation
Audio retained only for the period your policy sets
Supervisor edits logged against each report
compliance_notes: Permit-to-work and line clearance follow your safety rules and CEA safety regulations; voice reports do not change those steps.
Worker voice recordings are personal data and are handled with notice and retention limits under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: One maintenance crew or subdivision and two report types, such as breakdown restoration and preventive maintenance completion, in Hindi plus the local language.
deliverables: Vocabulary list and templates agreed with supervisors
Voice reporting in the pilot app or a call-in number
Integration plan for the CMMS and stores

what_we_measure.how: Share of reports with all mandatory fields filled when first submitted.
Number of fields changed by supervisors per report.
Transcription accuracy on a sample containing asset and spares terms.
Time from job completion to submitted report, compared with current practice.

faqs.q: Will it work in noisy places like substations and conveyor galleries?
faqs.a: We test on recordings from your sites and tune for background noise. Short follow-up questions help where a phrase was not caught, and the technician can always type a correction.

faqs.q: What if there is no network on site?
faqs.a: Recordings are stored on the phone and processed when the network returns. The technician gets any follow-up questions then, while the job is still fresh.
Hindi and Hinglish, plus regional languages such as Marathi, Gujarati, Odia, Bengali, Telugu or Tamil depending on your crews. Technical terms in English are handled within the same sentence.

faqs.q: Does this replace our permit-to-work system?
faqs.a: No. Permit issue, isolation and closure stay in your existing process. The voice report records what was done once the job is complete.
